title: Trust and Safety Analyst
summary: Trust and safety analysts review content and accounts against a platform's rules, act on harmful material and spot new abuse trends. They sit in the safety or policy operations team of a social, video or marketplace platform, or at a firm that runs this work for one.
dailyDuties: Review flagged posts, videos and accounts against policy guidelines
Escalate sensitive cases to policy or legal teams
Track abuse and scam trends in the review queues
Prepare queue volume and accuracy reports
Write decision notes and flag gaps in the guidelines
Join quality calibrations and wellness sessions

skills.expectation: Review content and accounts against platform policies and take the right action, using wellness practices to cope with disturbing material
Spot new abuse, spam and scam patterns in queue data and report them to policy teams
Escalate sensitive or unclear cases to policy, legal or law-enforcement teams on time
Pull and summarise case data with SQL
Track queues, accuracy and trends in Excel or Google Sheets
Write clear decision notes and feed policy gaps back to the team
Build reports and dashboards on volumes, accuracy and abuse trends
Prepare daily and weekly queue MIS
Audit reviewer decisions against the guidelines
Rate generative AI outputs for safety and policy issues
Handle user data under Indian and global privacy rules
Script simple checks on large case sets
Work with product, policy and vendor teams

certifications.why: Shows SQL and dashboard basics for moderators moving into analyst work
